mapper.select: SELECT id, name, JSON_SERIALIZE(attributes) AS attributes FROM products WHERE JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.price' RETURNING NUMBER) > #{min} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, JSON_SERIALIZE(attributes) AS attributes FROM products WHERE JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.price') > #{min} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, JSON_SERIALIZE(attributes) AS attributes FROM products WHERE JSON_EXISTS(attributes, '$.tags[*]?(@ == $tag)' PASSING #{tag} AS "tag") ORDER BY id
SELECT jt.tag FROM products p, JSON_TABLE(p.attributes, '$.tags[*]' COLUMNS (tag VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$')) jt WHERE p.id = #{id}
